text: This report recommends approval of the re-naming of Dunbloor Road to "Dundas Street West". Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the renaming of Dunbloor Road to "Dundas Street West" shown as PART 1 on Sketch No. PS-2019-143. __________ Etobicoke York Community Council held a public meeting on January 8, 2020, and notice was given in accordance with the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Notice of the proposed enactment of the draft by-laws was posted on the Public Notice page of the City's website.
